content.description: Floor is a mobile app for iOS and Android that helps you understand your NFT holdings, discover new collectibles, and engage with the Web3 communities behind each token. By surfacing insights and easy navigation, Floor makes it simpler to explore what you own, spot promising projects, and connect with peers who share your interests. Over the past year, thousands of NFT enthusiasts have relied on Floor, and the app is available on the App Store and Google Play for download.
content.meta: Floor is a mobile app for iOS and Android that helps users access the NFT ecosystem. Discover Floor and other NFT Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
